verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Workers docs state the story almost word for word: connect to databases, APIs, and storage via Bindings with just a few lines of code (cloudflare-docs-10). Data products can be queried directly from Workers with no connection management (cloudflare-docs-4), and binding usage is shown concretely through `env.Sandbox` (cloudflare-supp-sandbox-sdk) and the AI Search Workers binding (cloudflare-supp-ai-search). A community user reports getting a KV-backed API into production within an hour (cloudflare-comm-3). Missing for 10: detailed binding configuration docs or examples, explicit evidence for binding to third-party (non-Cloudflare) databases and APIs, and documentation of how bindings remove credential handling.
